'''The Forgotten Cemetery''' is a minor area in the [[Wilderness]] at around level 30. It contains [[ankou]], [[ghosts]], [[skeletons]], [[zombies]], and a [[man]]. The cemetery is visited by those wishing to complete the [[Wilderness Diary]], as a medium task requires the player to kill an ankou in the Wilderness and is the one of the two locations where they can be found.

The [[Agility shortcut]] (level 60) just north-west of the cemetery is a one-way shortcut from the [[God Wars Dungeon]] into the Wilderness.

[[Ian's Wilderness Cape Shop]], which sells the “X” pattern [[team cape]]s, can be found inside the cemetery itself.

The cemetery is often visited as it contains a location for a coordinate [[Treasure Trails/Guide/Coordinates/Hard|hard clue]].

==Transportation==
*Use [[Cemetery Teleport]] (spell or portal in POH) or the [[Cemetery teleport (tablet)|Cemetery teleport tablet]], which will teleport you directly to the cemetery.
*Use [[Dareeyak Teleport]] or [[Dareeyak teleport]] tablet, which will teleport you to ruins, south of the cemetery.
*
*Use [[burning amulet]] to teleport to [[Lava Maze]], then run south-west. This WILL take you to level 41 Wilderness.
*If you have access to choose a [[Wilderness Obelisk]], you can select the level 27, teleport, and run west.

==Trivia==
*Interestingly enough, there is a single [[man]] who wanders the cemetery. His dialogue is the same as other men found throughout [[Gielinor]] and he doesn't show any signs that he is in an extremely dangerous area. His drops and [[pickpocketing]] loot are also the same as other men.
